strats.naive: dense find top_k=5 + L2 hydrate（= prod baseline）
strats.advanced: dense find k=15 粗水化 + grep 擴 query + dedupe + score gate
strats.hybrid: dense find k=15 + sparse grep terms -> RRF(k=60) 融合
strats.corrective: find -> LLM self-check -> rewrite -> re-find -> 再差 skip 注入
strats.adaptive: LLM router 決定查唔查（trap/SKIP 就唔查）
strats.hyde: LLM 生成 hypothetical doc -> 用埋當 query dense find（HyDE，k=5）
